title: INT of a currency is a currency

source.quote: If <Number> is a Currency , then the result is also a Currency data type
source.supports: the result type for a currency argument
Microsoft only says a whole number: the other reading

derivation: INT rounds 2.5 down to 2. The argument is a currency, so the result is the currency 2.0.
alternative: INT always returns the Integer type: 2 (int64).
notes: DAX Guide is specific about the currency case; the Microsoft page is general.
